scope: causal voltage estimate, event plan and permission/publication core only; no PMSM load or integrated SMO performance claim

bridge.oracle: independent enumeration of open/lower-diode/upper-diode paths, floating-star KCL and diode complementarity; no plant rotor state or DUT answer reuse
bridge.ambiguity: any both-OFF phase inside estimated zero-current band, or excessive measured zero sequence, must mark voltage untrusted

deadtime.oracle: run-length intervals computed before DUT execution; rising effective at start+ceil(deadtime/h), falling immediate; shorter pulses suppressed
deadtime.check: all6 gates, no shoot-through, native-grid alignment, repeated-tick idempotence, rejected skipped/reversed ticks

schedule.oracle: explicit enumeration of timer UEV ticks; independently find first allowed UEV strictly after write and first UEV after JEOS; compare every physical time and permission
schedule.check: ABC aperture times, JEOS, release, observer ready, FOC write, intended/actual UEV, reserved margin, equal-time priority, next-frame overrun

publication.oracle: predeclared expected permission/fault masks; analytic constant-speed angles at three distinct timestamps; invalid control outputs zero plus false permission, raw diagnostics retained
publication.no_truth: packet fields are declared synthetic estimated state, not motor truth used as a correction

reject_invalid_inputs: nonfinite/negative durations, non-grid physical timestamps, incompatible ADC slots, invalid gate combinations, negative bus/drop parameters, malformed packet sequence/time
replay: two independent fresh MATLAB processes, same source/contract hashes and MATLAB release; all raw numeric/logical arrays and metrics isequaln; MAT container hashes only integrity
guard: source/contract snapshots and phase record before execution; no source changes while either test executes; preserve all failures
gate: R0 completion is component evidence only; main-model integration and v2 combined performance remain R1/R2/R3
